Numerical methods thus perpetually approach but never close the gap, while exact symbolic/SAT searches fail because the target point is not in the variety at all.","counterconditions":[{"case":"A sandbox-verified exact rank-22 decomposition of <3,3,3> is produced (directly refutes the nonexistence claim).","eval":"observation"},{"case":"ALS on rank-22 for <3,3,3> converges to a residual within machine-epsilon of zero, suggesting exact rank-22 exists and the stall is a search-coverage problem, not a border-rank gap.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"The border rank of <3,3,3> is proven equal to its rank (eliminates the gap mechanism entirely).","eval":"observation"},{"case":"A rank-22 decomposition is found modulo a small prime p but fails to lift to characteristic zero, which would instead support a modular obstruction hypothesis rather than a border-rank gap.","eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"The rank-22 variety in (F^9 \u2297 F^9 \u2297 F^9) is an algebraic variety whose closure contains tensors of border rank \u2264 22. If border_rank(<3,3,3>) < rank(<3,3,3>), then <3,3,3> lies in the closure of the rank-22 variety but not in the variety itself. ALS (alternating least squares) minimizes the Frobenius residual ||<3,3,3> - \u03a3_k u_k\u2297v_k\u2297w_k|| and will converge toward a boundary point with positive residual, explaining decades of near-misses. SAT/Groebner searches encode exact membership in the variety, which is false, explaining their failure. The symmetry group of <3,3,3> (order \u2265 6\u00b7|S_3|\u00b7|GL_3| automorphisms per block [695e3101e0b7bef8]) further constrains the boundary geometry, potentially forcing the nearest boundary point into a high-symmetry orbit that ALS struggles to identify. A sandbox simulation can discriminate this from competing hypotheses (e.g., 'rank-22 exists but ALS is trapped in local minima') by checking whether the ALS residual for rank-22 on <3,3,3> stabilizes at a strictly positive plateau versus oscillating, and by calibrating the verifier on Strassen's rank-7 <2,2,2> where the residual must reach exactly zero.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
